translation.title: Translate an app store listing to Spanish

The brand name "Lumo" is kept unchanged

menu-es.title: Spanish menu for a cafe
menu-es.description: Translate the Ember & Oak cafe menu into Spanish for a new Madrid branch. The 12 items: Espresso $3.00, Cappuccino $4.25, Oat latte $4.75, Hot chocolate $4.50, Iced tea $3.75, Fresh orange juice $4.50, Butter croissant $3.50, Almond croissant $4.25, Avocado toast $9.50, Ham and cheese sandwich $8.75, Granola bowl $8.50, Banana bread $3.75.
criteria: Delivered as a Markdown or text file
All 12 items have Spanish names
Every price is unchanged

candles.title: Five product descriptions for a candle shop
candles.description: Short web-shop descriptions for five soy candles from Wick & Ember: Cedar Smoke, Fig Leaf, Sea Salt, Black Tea, Orange Peel. 40 to 80 words each, warm and plain, no exclamation marks.
criteria: All five candles have a description
Each description is 40 to 80 words
No exclamation marks anywhere

cli-readme.title: README for a tiny CLI tool
cli-readme.description: Write the README for "brisk", a command-line timer. "brisk 25m" starts a 25-minute timer, "brisk --list" shows past timers, "brisk --sound off" mutes the bell. It installs with "npm i -g brisk-timer". MIT licence.
criteria: Delivered as a Markdown file
Explains how to install it
Shows all three commands with an example each
Mentions the MIT licence

email-validator.title: Email validation function with tests
email-validator.description: A Python function is_valid_email(address) for our signup form, with unit tests. It should accept normal addresses, reject obviously broken ones (no @, no domain, double dots, spaces inside), ignore surrounding whitespace, and return False for non-strings.
criteria: A Python function is_valid_email is delivered
It rejects addresses without an @ or without a domain
Unit tests are included
The tests actually check valid and invalid addresses
